page.text:
Farnoush Drexel
Saratoga Union School District
# Farnoush
Drexel
For School Board
INTEGRITY • COLLABORATION • ACADEMIC EXCELLENCE
Meet Farnoush View Priorities
Election Day November 3, 2026
Saratoga, California
A commitment to SUSD
## Rooted in the schools.
Focused on students.
Since my children entered SUSD in 2018, I have been deeply involved in our schools and community through PTA leadership, the Saratoga Education Foundation, classroom volunteering, and school fundraising.
As a dentist, small-business owner, and mother of two children still in the district, I bring empathy, sound judgment, hands-on experience managing a business budget, and a personal stake in keeping SUSD strong.
Read more about Farnoush →
A commitment to SUSD
## Why I’m Running
I am running for the Saratoga Union School District Board because I believe our students deserve a school district where adults work together, listen to one another and remain focused on what matters most: our children.
I am running to help bring greater unity, collaboration, accountability and trust to our school board while protecting our academic excellence, supporting our outstanding teachers, promoting student well-being and ensuring our resources are used wisely.
Our differences should never be greater than our shared commitment to our children.
What matters most
## Top priorities

Farnoush Drexel
## Endorsements
ORGANIZATIONAL ENDORSEMENT
### Saratoga Teachers Association Endorses Farnoush Drexel
For SUSD School Board
## Elected Officials Endorsements
- Honorable Katherine Tseng, Vice President LGSUHSD Board of Trustees; Former President of Saratoga High Foundation, Saratoga Education Foundation and Saratoga Music Booster.
- Honorable Howard Miller, Former Mayor of Saratoga, Retired Apple Executive, West Valley STEM Faculty
- Honorable David Guidry, Former Los Gatos-Saratoga Union High School District Board Trustee
- Honorable Sheeba Garg, Community Volunteer and Parent of SUSD Alumni
- Honorable Mary-Lynne Bernald, Former Mayor of the City of Saratoga
- Honorable Cindy Ruby, Community Volunteer, Former SUSD Board Member 1992–2012
- Honorable Cathie Thermond, Community Volunteer, Former SUSD Board Member 2002–2006
- Honorable Cynthia Miller, Current SUSD Board Member
- Honorable Kookie Fitzsimmons , Current Saratoga City Council, Former Mayor of Saratoga
- Honorable Nai Hsueh, Director Valley Water District 5
- Honorable Cynthia Chang, Former LGSU HSD Board Member, Former SUSD Board Member, Former President of Asian Pacific Islanders School Board Members Association
- Honorable Chuck Page, Mayor of the City of Saratoga
- The Honorable Melissa Stanis, SUSD Governing Board Member, SUSD Governing Board President 2022–2025
- The Honorable Pragati Grover, Former Saratoga Union School District Trustee
- The Honorable Andrea Yvette Bryan, Superior Court Judge, Retired
Chuck Page, Mayor of the City of Saratoga
“Farnoush has the experience and team building skills to provide the best leadership for the SUSD board.”
Luu Pham, Retired Police Sergeant
I’m proud to support Farnoush Drexel for school board member. （click to read the full endorsement）
I’m proud to support Farnoush Drexel for school board member. I’m a retired Detective Sergeant with 28 years experience with the San Jose Police Department. Our families have known each other for approximately six years and we both have a sixth grader attending Redwood Middle School. I believe as a school board member, Farnoush will listens to families’ concerns, values every student, and brings practical ideas to strengthen our schools. I believe in her leadership and commitment to our community. Most importantly, Farnoush is a person of high integrity. I trust her to always do the best thing for the students and their family.
The Honorable Melissa Stanis, Saratoga Union School District Board Member
She brings exactly what our schools and our community need: unwavering integrity, genuine passion, thoughtful intelligence, and deep empathy. （click to read the full endorsement）
I am proud to endorse Farnoush Drexel for SUSD School Board. She brings exactly what our schools and our community need: unwavering integrity, genuine passion, thoughtful intelligence, and deep empathy. Her years of dedicated service to our schools demonstrate that she doesn’t simply talk about supporting students, educators, and families; she shows up, does the work, listens, and leads with purpose. She approaches difficult issues with both a sharp mind and an open heart, always focused on what is best for students and our community. I have tremendous respect for her character, her commitment, and her willingness to serve, and she has wholeheartedly earned my vote and my endorsement.
The Honorable Pragati Grover, Former Saratoga Union School District Trustee
Farnoush is deeply passionate about fostering supportive learning environments, maintaining academic excellence, and ensuring every student has the resources they need to succeed. （click to read the full endorsement）
I am proud to support Farnoush Drexel for the Saratoga Union School District Board (SUSD). Farnoush is deeply passionate about fostering supportive learning environments, maintaining academic excellence, and ensuring every student has the resources they need to succeed. Farnoush’s thoughtful approach and commitment to our schools make them the right choice for SUSD.
The Honorable Andrea Yvette Bryan, Former Santa Clara County Superior Court Judge
I admire Farnoush for her integrity, thoughtfulness and genuine commitment to our community. （click to read the full endorsement）
I admire Farnoush for her integrity, thoughtfulness and genuine commitment to our community. She considers different perspectives and approaches challenges with both compassion & good judgment. These qualities will make Farnoush an exceptional addition to the SUSD Board.
Ann Borgia-Camp, Retired Educator of SUSD of 39 years
It is my distinct privilege to offer my heartfelt endorsement of Farnoush Drexel for the Saratoga Union School District Board. (click to read full endorsement)
It is my distinct privilege to offer my heartfelt endorsement of Farnoush Drexel for the Saratoga Union School District Board. Having dedicated 39 years to educating students in SUSD, I have had the absolute pleasure of teaching Farnoush’s children and collaborating directly with her over the past five years. Throughout that time, her unwavering commitment to our students, staff, and broader school community has been unmistakable.
Farnoush brings a remarkable blend of professional expertise and practical leadership to our district. As a former dentistry business owner, attorney, and author, she combines sharp strategic insight with an exceptional work ethic. Beyond her professional achievements, she embodies the principle of continuous learning—approaching every challenge with curiosity, open-mindedness, and a desire to grow.
Her commitment to SUSD is proven through active service. As a dedicated PTA leader and coordinator of our school Book Fair, she consistently steps up to serve. She is a compassionate listener, an innovative problem solver, and a steadfast ally to teachers. She approaches every decision by prioritizing the best interests of all students, ensuring that every child in our district has the support they need to thrive.
Farnoush believes in collaborative governance and recognizes that our district is strongest when Board members work constructively together. I have complete confidence that her vision, integrity, and collaborative spirit will help Saratoga Union School District remain the strong district it is while elevating it to even greater heights.
I whole-heartedly support Farnoush Drexel for the SUSD School Board and encourage our community to do the same.
Nikita Variava, President, Saratoga High MAP Boosters
I am proud to endorse Farnoush Drexel for the Saratoga Union School District Board of Trustees. Having worked alongside Farnoush at Redwood Middle School PTA, I have come to know her as sincere, diligent, and deeply committed to our school community. She consistently shows up, lends her support where needed, and follows through with care and dedication. (click to read full endorsement)
I am proud to endorse Farnoush Drexel for the Saratoga Union School District Board of Trustees. Having worked alongside Farnoush at Redwood Middle School PTA, I have come to know her as sincere, diligent, and deeply committed to our school community. She consistently shows up, lends her support where needed, and follows through with care and dedication.
Mahshid Maleki, District Booster President and former Saratoga Elementary School Booster Club President
What I admire most about Farnoush is that students are always at the center of her decisions. (click to read full endorsement)
I have had the privilege of working closely with Farnoush for the past six years, beginning with our time together at Saratoga Elementary School PTA and continuing through Redwood Middle School PTA and the Saratoga Education Foundation.
Over all these years, I have come to know Farnoush as someone who is honest, thoughtful, proactive, and deeply committed to our students. She doesn’t just volunteer her time, she truly cares about the children, families, teachers, and staff in our community.
Whether she was organizing book fairs, school events, galas, staff appreciation events, supporting fundraising efforts, or taking on other PTA and community initiatives, Farnoush always brought the same energy, care, and commitment. She worked collaboratively, listened to different perspectives, and always looked for ways to bring people together and strengthen our school community.
What I admire most about Farnoush is that students are always at the center of her decisions. She genuinely cares about their safety, happiness, well-being, and opportunities to succeed. She believes in fairness and making sure that every student is considered and supported. She is kind and compassionate, but she is also someone who will ask important questions, speak honestly, and work collaboratively to find the best solution.
After working alongside her for so many years and across different schools and organizations, I trust Farnoush to make thoughtful, responsible, and fair decisions for all of our students. I would be truly happy to see someone with her integrity, heart, experience, and commitment serving our community on the School Board.
I wholeheartedly support Farnoush and am proud to endorse her.
Erin Gavin, SUSD Parent
“Competent and honest leadership to represent all students of SUSD”
Amanda Wroblewski, Former District Booster Club President and Saratoga Elementary Booster Club President
“I've had several opportunities to volunteer with Farnoush over the years, and every time she comes thoroughly prepared, asks informed questions, and stays focused on advocating for our school community. She fully commits to her work and respects the people around her, even when the conversations get difficult. That kind of steadiness is what our kids' classrooms need when real decisions are being made.”
Camila Ferguson, Saratoga Community Volunteer and SUSD Parent
I have great respect for Farnoush’s work ethic, transparency, honesty, and sound judgment. (click to read full endorsement)
I have great respect for Farnoush’s work ethic, transparency, honesty, and sound judgment. She approaches her work thoughtfully and responsibly, and I believe she has the integrity and commitment needed to serve our schools and community well.
I strongly support Farnoush Drexel for School Board and encourage others to support her as well.
Lorrie Peeters ESQ, Redwood Middle School Booster Club President
Farnoush will approach difficult decisions thoughtfully, listen to our community with an open mind, and never lose sight of what matters most: providing our students, educators, and administrators with the support they need to thrive. (click to read full endorsement)
I could not be more proud to endorse Farnoush Drexel for the SUSD School Board. Farnoush will approach difficult decisions thoughtfully, listen to our community with an open mind, and never lose sight of what matters most: providing our students, educators, and administrators with the support they need to thrive.
By sheer good fortune, Farnoush and I arrived at Saratoga Elementary together eight years ago, each with two children in the same grades. In the years since, my admiration for her - as a parent, trusted friend, advisor, and dedicated community volunteer - has only grown.
Farnoush brings an unusually broad range of life experiences to everything she does, and she draws on them with thoughtfulness, perspective, and purpose. She is meticulous, deeply engaged, and one of the most attentive parents I know. Just as importantly, she cares profoundly about the strength and well-being of the community she calls home.
Farnoush does not simply care about our schools; she consistently puts that care into action. She has devoted countless hours to PTA leadership, classroom volunteering, organizing book fairs that reflect her love of reading and learning, and raising funds to support enrichment opportunities for our students. When something matters to her community, she shows up, does the work, and follows through. When she sees a problem, she works thoughtfully toward a solution that accounts for competing needs and perspectives. She knows which issues warrant attention, keeps the bigger picture in focus, and understands the importance of preserving productive relationships so that everyone can move forward together in service of the greater good.
I also admire that Farnoush is deeply intellectually curious. She makes a point of staying informed about issues affecting our schools and community, as well as broader developments shaping the world our children are growing into. She listens carefully, seeks out different perspectives, asks thoughtful questions, and is willing to learn before reaching conclusions.
That combination of curiosity, empathy, diligence, intellect, and a strong internal compass is exactly what I believe the SUSD Board needs. I am proud to endorse her.
Melody Mansoor, SUSD Parent & Community Volunteer
I’ve gotten to know Farnoush through our involvement on the PTA and SEF boards, and I’ve always found her to be approachable, thoughtful, and deeply committed to our schools. As an SUSD parent, she understands the concerns of our families and is genuinely invested in the future of our school community. (click to read full endorsement)
I’ve gotten to know Farnoush through our involvement on the PTA and SEF boards, and I’ve always found her to be approachable, thoughtful, and deeply committed to our schools. As an SUSD parent, she understands the concerns of our families and is genuinely invested in the future of our school community.
Sangeeta Mallik, Ph.D., Former Redwood Middle School Booster Club President
I had the privilege of volunteering and working closely with Farnoush over several years while I was an SUSD parent. (click to read full endorsement)
I had the privilege of volunteering and working closely with Farnoush over several years while I was an SUSD parent. Farnoush is authentic, honest, organized and gives 100 percent to any cause she chooses to support. She is passionate about our educational community and leading with empathy, kindness and courage and she executes her vision with clarity and conscientiousness. It is a pleasure for me to endorse Farnoush to serve on SUSD School Board!
Mary Ko, Former Argonaut Booster Club President, SUSD Leader and Volunteer and Saratoga High School Leader and Volunteer
Farnoush is the kind of volunteer who doesn’t just show up—she gets involved, listens, collaborates, and gets things done. (click to read full endorsement)
I’m happy to endorse Farnoush for SUSD School Board!
I’ve had the pleasure of working alongside Farnoush through the Redwood Middle School PTA. I’ve seen firsthand her incredible dedication to our students, families, and school community.
Farnoush is the kind of volunteer who doesn’t just show up—she gets involved, listens, collaborates, and gets things done. She brings thoughtfulness, compassion, and a genuine desire to make our schools better. She has volunteered for our school community for many years, and she truly understands the needs of our schools from many different perspectives.
I truly believe that her experience as a parent volunteer and her deep involvement in our school community would make her an outstanding School Board member.
I’m excited to support Farnoush and encourage our community to support her too!
Melissa Lin, Saratoga Community Volunteer and SUSD Parent
Farnoush has all the qualifications I look for in a SUSD School Board candidate. (click to read full endorsement)
Farnoush has all the qualifications I look for in a SUSD School Board candidate. She has been actively involved and engaged in our school community for years, taking on leadership roles in our school PTA, I value Farnoush's clear commitment to our students and her strong conviction. She has used her experience and background to promote programs that benefit all our students. And she has used her voice to speak up when there are issues that concern our community. It is my pleasure to endorse Farnoush for SUSD School Board, and I encourage others to do the same.
Monique Cintra, SUSD Parent & Community Volunteer at Argonaut, RMS & SHS
I strongly endorse Farnoush. (click to read full endorsement)
I strongly endorse Farnoush. Having worked with her at the RMS PTA, I’ve come to know her as a kind, proactive, and empathetic person who truly cares about our community, students, and staff. She consistently approaches her role with excellence, integrity, and a genuine commitment to making a positive difference.
Maggie Sheu, Saratoga Community Volunteer and SUSD Parent
What I admire most about Farnoush is her integrity and courage. She speaks up when it matters, stands behind our educators and school leaders when they need support, and holds her ground even when doing so isn’t easy. (click to read full endorsement)
I’ve had the privilege of knowing Farnoush for many years, both as a friend and as a fellow parent in our school community. Throughout the time, I’ve seen her consistently give her time, energy, and heart to our schools. Whether it’s volunteering in classrooms, supporting school programs or events, she always looks for ways to make the experience better for our students.
What I admire most about Farnoush is her integrity and courage. She speaks up when it matters, stands behind our educators and school leaders when they need support, and holds her ground even when doing so isn’t easy. She approaches difficult situations with a strong sense of what is fair and, above all, what is best for our students and community.
Farnoush is a kind and caring friend, but also a person of conviction and strong resolve. I have tremendous respect for her willingness to step forward and serve. I’m proud to endorse Farnoush for the SUSD Board of Trustees.
Daniela Goto, Saratoga Elementary School Booster Club Leader and SUSD Parent
I’m proud to endorse Farnoush for SUSD school board. She is a competent, thoughtful leader who is deeply involved with our school community. (click to read full endorsement)
I’m proud to endorse Farnoush for SUSD school board. She is a competent, thoughtful leader who is deeply involved with our school community. She understands the needs of students, families, teachers, and staff because she is actively engaged in the life of our school.
I trust her to listen, make informed decisions, and work hard to ensure our schools continue to provide the best possible education for our students.
Dr. Charlie and Yvonne Goss, Parents of Saratoga Alumni
“We highly endorse Farnoush. She will be a positive force for our schools.”
- Sandy Miller, Former Saratoga Music Booster Executive Board and Treasurer
